race.description: Peter Ball Memorial / Hammer & Tong Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: SHE'S A WILD ONE (1) on top after a dominant Coffs Harbour win on soft ground and a narrow Bowraville second last week, where she was bumped at the start and raced keenly. The move from picnic level to stronger company is the test, but the 3kg claim and her deep 1000m record make her the one to beat. SWEET ENCHANTRESS (6) is lightly raced and arrives off a first-up Mdn win at Coffs Harbour, although the 1000m record is still a query. LOVE YOU ANYWAY (3) drops out of BM58 form and places often enough at this trip to be a genuine exotics player. SEENI (4) is back from an eight-month break with a recent Scone trial.
